name: Skola Vale
description: An enchanted chaparral valley on Theros blessed by Nylea, ancestral home of the satyrs and a place of carefree revelry.

description_citations.text: "Skola Vale". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: According to myth, Nylea pours her wineskin over the valley, giving it life and turning goats into the first satyrs.
timeline.quote: she poured her wineskin over it, infusing the land with life and turning the goats who drank from it into the first satyrs

citation.text: "Skola Vale". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Nylea is the patron of the valley.
relations.quote: As the patron of the valley, Nylea is the most heavily worshipped in Skola Vale

citation.text: "Skola Vale", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The chaparral is to the northeast of Theros, sharing a border with Setessa .
